fallback.title: No devices found
fallback.description: No Airfi devices were found on your network. You can search again or add a device manually.

fallback_error.title: Search could not start
fallback_error.description: Home Assistant could not search your network for Airfi devices. Try again in a moment, or add a device manually.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: If you need help with the configuration, have a look at the [documentation]({documentation_url}).

data_description.host: The IP address of the Airfi device on your local network.
data_description.serial_number: The digits shown on the device's type plate, in the Airfi app or web interface, or in the list of found devices. Home Assistant uses the serial number to find the device again if its IP address changes.
data_description.model_name: Pick the model shown on the device's type plate, such as Model 60, or the exact model name from the Airfi app. Unless you enter a name, the model names the device in Home Assistant.
data_description.name: Leave empty to name the device Airfi and its model. The entity IDs are formed from this name, so when you add a device again, give it the name it had before.

discovery_select.title: Select discovered device
discovery_select.description: Airfi devices found: {count}. Select one to continue.

data_description.device: Each device is listed with its model, IP address, and serial number. The last two options search for more devices or let you add a device manually.

discovery_confirm.title: Confirm device
discovery_confirm.description:
**{model}** at {host} (serial number {serial})

You can give the device a name of your own.

data_description.name: Airfi and its model unless you change it. The entity IDs are formed from this name, so when you add a device again, give it the name it had before.

modbus_id.title: Check the Modbus ID
modbus_id.description: The device at {host} was found, but it did not answer. This usually means its Modbus ID is something other than the usual 1. Enter the device's Modbus ID.

data_description.modbus_id: Usually 1. You can find it in the Airfi app under Info, or on the device in the Potentiometric setup menu, item U1.

reconfigure.description: Enter the current IP address of {name}.

data_description.host: The IP address of the Airfi device on your local network.

data_description.modbus_id: Change this only if the device's Modbus ID is not 1. You can find it in the Airfi app under Info, or on the device in the Potentiometric setup menu, item U1.

reconfigure_unverified.title: Use this IP address?
reconfigure_unverified.description: Home Assistant could not confirm that the device at {host} is {name}. This can happen on some networks even when the address is right. If you are sure the address is correct, select Submit.

progress.discovering_devices: Searching your network for Airfi devices. This may take 5 to 15 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Check the IP address and that the device is powered on.
error.cannot_retrieve_data: Connected, but could not read the device's data. Check that the IP address belongs to an Airfi device.
error.no_response: The device did not answer. Check its Modbus ID.
error.invalid_serial: Enter the serial number as digits only.
error.wrong_device: This IP address belongs to a different Airfi device. Check the address and try again.
error.serial_mismatch: The device at this IP address has a different serial number. Check the IP address and the serial number.
error.unsupported_device: The device's software is too old or not supported. Update the device's software, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.invalid_selection: The selected device is no longer available.
abort.already_in_progress: This device is already being set up.
abort.not_airfi_device: This device is not an Airfi unit.

device_unreachable.message: Unable to connect to device at {host}.

setup_firmware_error.message: The device's software is not supported: firmware {firmware_version}, register map {map_version}. Update the device's software, then reload the integration.

update_failed.message: Failed to update data from the device.

update_failed_rediscovery.message: Device was rediscovered but data refresh still failed.

first_refresh_failed.message: Could not load initial data from the device at {host}.

setup_invalid_device_data.message: Failed to retrieve valid device data from the air handling unit. Check that it is powered on and connected to the network.

write_failed.message: Could not send the command to the Airfi unit: the write to register {register} failed.

write_failed_unreachable.message: Could not send the command to the Airfi unit at {host}: the unit did not respond.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device at this IP address. Check the address and that the device is powered on.
error.cannot_retrieve_data: Connected, but could not read the device's data. Check that the IP address belongs to an Airfi device.
error.no_response: The device did not answer. Check its Modbus ID.
error.wrong_device: This IP address belongs to a different Airfi device. Check the address and try again.
error.unsupported_device: The device's software is too old or not supported. Update the device's software, then try again.

init.title: {name} is unreachable
init.description: Home Assistant cannot reach {name}. If its IP address has changed, enter the new one. If not, keep the current address and check that the device is powered on and connected to your network.

data_description.host: The current IP address of the Airfi device.

modbus_id.title: {name} does not answer
modbus_id.description: {name} was found at {host}, but it did not answer. If its Modbus ID has been changed, enter the new one.

data_description.modbus_id: Usually 1. You can find it in the Airfi app under Info, or on the device in the Potentiometric setup menu, item U1.

unverified.title: Use this IP address?
unverified.description: Home Assistant could not confirm that the device at {host} is {name}. This can happen on some networks even when the address is right. If you are sure the address is correct, select Submit.

unsupported_firmware.title: {name} needs a software update
unsupported_firmware.description:
This integration does not support the device's software: firmware {firmware_version}, register map {map_version}. It needs register map 2.0 or newer, and firmware 3.2.0 does not work with it.

1. Update the device's software as the support section of the [Airfi website]({airfi_url}) describes (**airfi.fi/en** > **Support** > **Software update**).
2. Reload the integration: **Settings** > **Devices & services** > **Airfi** > ⋮ > **Reload**.
